target.title: fix(ci): repair ratchet baseline drift
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The TypeScript LOC ratchet compares a PR's versioned baseline directly with current file sizes, so ordinary `main` drift can make unrelated PRs fail even when the PR adds no growth. This replaces #105919 because its contributor branch does not allow maintainer edits.

The latest sidebar refactor also exposed four file-local parameter types as dead exports and left its settings-navigation E2E using the retired direct link.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Bound LOC-baseline catch-up by the physical LOC already present at the comparison ref.
- Keep missing comparison files fail-closed and continue rejecting branch-local growth.
- Refresh the LOC baseline from current Linux `main`.
- Make the four sidebar parameter types file-local instead of growing the dead-export baseline.
- Exercise Settings through the footer Agent menu, matching the current UI.
- Preserve contributor credit for @vincentkoc in the commit trailer.

## User Impact

CI ratchets stop blocking unrelated PRs on pre-existing `main` drift. The sidebar E2E again validates the actual Settings entry point. No runtime behavior changes.

## Evidence

- Testbox `tbx_01kxcs9q18wzj6c0fm4d595vcn`: 53 focused tests passed across the LOC script, sidebar unit tests, and sidebar mocked-Gateway E2E.
- `pnpm tsgo:scripts`
- `pnpm tsgo:ui`
- `node --import tsx scripts/check-ts-max-loc.ts --max 500 --base-ref origin/main`
- `pnpm deadcode:exports` (`5526` entries matched)
- Final exact-base regeneration on Testbox `tbx_01kxcsp12ha9jcevypycvf2nt3` was byte-identical; both ratchets passed.
- Fresh autoreview: no findings; patch correct at 0.91 confidence.

Closes #105919.
